_comment: Small-instance supplement to the pilot (B6, 9 Nov; needs the group's OK before it is run). Reason: the main pilot gave EASY 2 / MEDIUM 1 against targets 4 / 5, and only n = 50 was easy. Same generator, same seed 201, same W = 0.75 L and same pilot limits as pilot/grid.json; n = 20-80, m in {2, 3}, L in {360, 480}: 20 configurations, 19 run. Excluded: rt_n20_m3_L480_s201, whose reference schedule has a median of 2.5 trips per duty (< 3, density rule Q2), checked in memory on 9 Nov before this file was written. Results are appended to results/pilot.csv and classified with the same written rule.
